newsitem.title: USA: Commerce Bancshares sets stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Commerce Bancshares sets stock dividend.

text.p: Commerce Bancshares Inc said Friday its board of directors declared a five percent stock dividend.
The dividend is payable December 13 to shareholders of record November 29, the bank holding company said.
The company also declared a $0.19 a share cash dividend, unchanged from the previous quarter.
The record and pay dates for the cash dividend are the same as the stock dividend, but the cash dividend will be paid on shares before the stock dividend, controller Jeffery Aberdeen said.
The stock was down 1/8 to 39-3/8 on Nasdaq Friday.
